questions.haul_item: What equipment will you be hauling (e.g. skid steer, mini excavator, tractor)?
questions.payload_capacity: What's the rough total weight of the load?
questions.length: About how long is the load (or what deck length do you need)?
questions.hitch_type: Do you prefer a bumper pull or gooseneck hitch?
questions.loading_style: How will you load it — ramps, deckover, or drive-over fenders?

answer_guidance.haul_item: Store the equipment or machinery the customer says they are hauling. Accept short noun phrases or free-form item descriptions. Loose-answer rule: store any substantive wording the user gives for this field, however broad or informal. Do not store it only when the user explicitly refuses/skips, asks a counter-question, or clearly answers another field.
answer_guidance.payload_capacity: Store the rough total load weight or payload requirement. Accept pounds, lbs, tons, or equivalent weight wording only. Loose-answer rule: accept digits, number words, ranges, or approximations; for every range store only the smallest stated value (15–18 ft becomes 15 ft; 5,000–10,000 lbs becomes 5,000 lbs). If a cooperative answer has no usable numeric value and is not a counter-question or another-field answer, skip this field as no preference; never invent or retry a value.
answer_guidance.length: Store the load length or desired deck length. Accept feet, inches, or clear size shorthand when length is being answered. Loose-answer rule: accept digits, number words, ranges, or approximations; for every range store only the smallest stated value (15–18 ft becomes 15 ft; 5,000–10,000 lbs becomes 5,000 lbs). If a cooperative answer has no usable numeric value and is not a counter-question or another-field answer, skip this field as no preference; never invent or retry a value.
answer_guidance.hitch_type: Store only bumper pull or gooseneck when the customer explicitly chooses a hitch preference. Loose-answer rule: store a recognizable value for this field. If the user is cooperative but vague/flexible and gives no usable field value, skip it as no preference; do not retry or invent a value.
answer_guidance.loading_style: Store how the customer wants to load the equipment, such as ramps, deckover, or drive-over fenders. Loose-answer rule: store a recognizable value for this field. If the user is cooperative but vague/flexible and gives no usable field value, skip it as no preference; do not retry or invent a value.
